description.description: A man in a grocery store aisle, dressed in a grey tank top with 'Member 9/11' and a bald eagle on it, cut-off denim shorts, and a Confederate flag bandana, holds a cigarette in his mouth while a woman with a microphone interviews him. The scene then cuts to a separate, humorous clip of a person in a pink shirt climbing a tall indoor rock climbing wall that has been edited to appear inside a grocery store aisle.

tweetMedia.transcription: We're here at Pleasant Mart in Shelby, North Carolina with the owner of Climbing Extravaganza. How's the day going? I done told the manager there's a fucking weight limit on this shit and he don't listen. Keeps letting them big women climb. When one of them come here with a lawsuit because they done blowed out, don't blame me. I'm getting dizzy up here, Curtis. My fingers are slipping. Damn, you're supposed to let us know when you want to come down. I can't hold on.
